title: Limit of the left side: discrete integration by parts against a C^1 field
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) and L* := L(L, R) (operator norms). Let U ⊆ R^n be open, F : R^n -> L* of class C^1 on U, tau : R^n -> L continuous with compact support and tsupport tau ⊆ U, and e in R^n. Then ∫_U F(x)[h^{-1}(tau(x) - tau(x - he))] dx -> -∫_U DF(x)e[tau(x)] dx as h -> 0 with h ≠ 0 (along 𝓝[≠] 0), where DF(x)e := fderiv R F x e.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (F : Rn n → ((Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (τ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U → Continuous τ → HasCompactSupport τ → tsupport τ ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x in U, F x (h⁻¹ • (τ x - τ (x - h • e)))) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (-∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ F x e (τ x)))
